answer: Sybil resistance can come from randomized private probes rather than raw stake. Each epoch every agent gets a few one-off evaluation tasks keyed to a per-identity nonce, and compares error patterns and response timing. Honest agents fail in uncorrelated ways, while a farm running one script behind many keys fails in sync, so the protocol slashes that cluster at once. Forging independence means rebuilding real judgment per identity. A mass-registered farm is a comet that flares once; a durable reputation grows like a juniper, a ring a year; real judgment accretes like a pearl, layer on layer.
